title: SEC7: missing FREE handler for WC_ALGO_TYPE_HASH leaks pool fd
description: When a streaming hash object (wc_Sha256, wc_Sha384, wc_Sha512) is freed via wc_Sha256Free() without a preceding wc_Sha256Final(), wolfSSL calls wc_CryptoCb_Free(devId, WC_ALGO_TYPE_HASH, ...). The crypto2dev callback dispatches on info->free.algo: CIPHER, HMAC, and PK are handled, but WC_ALGO_TYPE_HASH falls to default: return 0. Because the callback returns 0 (not CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE), wc_Sha256Free returns early without calling standard free code. The Crypto2DevHashCtx allocated in devCtx is leaked along with its op_fd pool slot. The pool slot is permanently lost. Under any workload that includes error-path or abandoned hashes, the pool drains and all future cipher/hash/HMAC operations fail with WC_HW_E. Fix: add a WC_ALGO_TYPE_HASH case in the FREE handler that closes the op_fd, calls crypto2dev_pool_release, and XFREEs the ctx.
